title: [AUG-175] Research: live mode Copy & Clear and Clear buttons, clear confirmation, Stop Live protection
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 3): live mode has only [ COPY ALL ] and [ STOP LIVE ]. Wanted: [Copy & Clear] (copy transcript and clear the window), a separate [Clear], a Settings option "Confirmation to clear transcript" against accidental loss, and protection for Stop Live — an accidental press costs more than the button is worth. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Current live controls described with file:line refs, in every place they appear (standard, Dock Strip, Ghost Caption).
- [x] Clear semantics defined: what is cleared (view only vs stored live transcript vs action items), effect on the saved session and on post-recording transcription.
- [x] Stop Live protection options compared (confirm, hold-to-stop, move to menu, remove) with a recommendation.
- [x] Confirmation setting: name, default, place in Settings proposed.
- [x] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-175/live-controls.html (opens in a browser, no build) with the live panel button row (COPY ALL, Copy & Clear, Clear, Stop Live) per option, working clear-confirmation and Stop Live protection interactions, and the new Settings checkbox; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [x] The user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [x] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Align the Stop protection pattern with the Ghost Mode research (same card series) so one pattern is used everywhere. Roadmap: M2 Live session control. Order: 6/10.

## Research (2026-11-03)
**Current controls:**
- Standard panel @client/src/components/LiveTranscriptPanel.tsx:101-111: Pause, Mute mic, Copy All, Clear All, Stop Live, End Recording. Clear All and Stop Live always show the "Are you sure?" inline confirm (:58, :119-131); it is not tied to Settings.
- Dock Strip @client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx:93-96: [ COPY ALL ] [ STOP LIVE ], with **no confirm** on STOP LIVE. This is what Rodion sees. Footer PAUSE · MUTE · END; END confirms unless skipStopConfirmation.
- Dock Square :233 [ STOP ] = end recording. Ghost Caption @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx:163-197 and Ghost Coin :332-358 have no Copy and no Stop Live, only END with "END?".
- Settings "Skip Clear Confirmation" (@client/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx:796-806, pref skipClearConfirmation) exists, but **no code reads it**.
- Stop Live (handleLiveStop, @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx:863-873) also wipes the visible lines.

**Clear semantics:** view only, via setLiveLines([]) (FileUpload.tsx:884-886). Live text is never saved, so session.json, transcript.md and the post-recording transcript are unaffected. Action items and participants (persisted by liveKey) are not cleared. Copy & Clear clears only after the clipboard write succeeds and never confirms.

**Stop Live options:** A confirm · B hold to stop · C ⋯ menu · D remove from compact (see mockup table).

## Decision (user, 2026-11-03)
- Stop Live → **B, hold to stop for 1.5 s** in the standard panel and the Dock Strip. It replaces the Stop confirm, is not skippable, and AUG-176 Ghost Stop Meeting must use the same component.
- Clear confirmation → reuse the existing **Skip Clear Confirmation** (default Off = ask) for Clear in both views; Copy & Clear never asks.
- Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-175/live-controls.html (option B is the default view).

## Implementation task
AUG-182-5jky01: Live mode: Copy & Clear and Clear buttons, working Skip Clear Confirmation, hold-to-stop Stop Live.
